wizards.title: Dark Wizards
wizards.tabTitle: Dark Wizards: guided helpers that prepare Generate for you
wizards.intro: Pick a wizard, give it a picture and a few words. It chooses the model and settings and prepares Generate; you check the Run Plan and press Run there.
wizards.replace.name: Replace
wizards.replace.summary: Swap a person, object or detail in a picture for something else.
wizards.replace.hint.reference: The picture goes to Generate as the reference of a Qwen Image 2.1 edit, at its own aspect ratio. Check the result size and press Run.
wizards.replace.hint.inpaint: Generate opens the picture in Inpaint with your text as the prompt. Paint over what should change, then press Run.
wizards.picture.chooseTitle: Choose the picture or video to change
wizards.picture.emptyBody: Or paste one with Ctrl+V, or use Choose… (PNG, JPEG or WebP; the picture to change may also be an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video)
wizards.picture.unsupported: Wizards take PNG, JPEG and WebP pictures; the picture to change may also be an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video.
wizards.picture.noInput: A pasted picture is saved to the Input folder first; set up the backend so DEAS knows that folder.
wizards.picture.size: The picture size could not be read; choose it again.
wizards.method.title: Method
wizards.method.noModel: No installed model for this method.
wizards.models.missing: No suitable model is installed. The wizard prefers {name}; the Library shows it with its license before anything is downloaded.
wizards.models.rescanHint: Checks the model folders again, for example after copying or downloading a model.
wizards.prepareNote: Nothing runs yet: Generate shows the draft and its Run Plan.
wizards.run.native: One-click running needs the desktop app.
wizards.run.maskHint: The masked method finds its mask with SAM 3.1 from “Replace what” in Generate; that needs a SAM 3.1 checkpoint and the SAM3_Detect node.
wizards.run.maskTarget: Name what to replace: SAM 3.1 uses it to find the mask.
wizards.run.noMask: SAM 3.1 found no “{target}” in the picture. Draw the mask in Generate and press Run there.
wizards.run.stopHint: Shown while the wizard’s run is queued or drawing.
wizards.run.openHint: Shown when the wizard’s run made a picture or stopped with a message; the prepared draft is in Generate.
wizards.run.succeeded: Done — the picture shows here and in Generate’s queue.
wizards.run.unknown: The outcome is unknown; check Generate’s queue.
wizards.run.notStarted: Generate could not start the draft; its message says why.
wizards.run.noFile: The run finished without a picture file.
wizards.handoff.model: Generate cannot use the model the wizard chose. Press Look again in the wizard, or pick another model there.
wizards.search.installedOnly: Shown when a suitable model is installed.
wizards.search.missingOnly: Shown when no suitable model is installed.
wizards.picture.objectBody: A picture of what should go in: a person, a product, a piece of clothing… Paste or drop goes to the highlighted area.
wizards.picture.objectUnused: This model uses only the text. The object picture needs a Qwen Image 2.1 model (both methods can use one).
wizards.replace.replacementObjectPlaceho: optional: the dog in the object picture
wizards.replace.hint.referenceObject: The picture to change becomes image 1 and the object picture image 2 of a Qwen Image 2.1 reference edit; the result keeps image 1's aspect ratio. Check the result size and press Run.
wizards.replace.objectRouted: With an object picture the wizard hands over the reference edit on the same model: a masked edit would keep the old object.
wizards.picture.offGrid: This picture is {size}. Inpaint with this model needs both sides on a multiple of {grid} px, so Generate keeps Run blocked for this picture.
wizards.picture.gridCopyHint: Saves a centred {size} crop as a new picture in the Input folder and uses it here. Only the few edge pixels past the grid are cut, nothing is resampled; the original stays unchanged.
wizards.picture.gridCopySmall: This picture is too small to crop onto the grid; choose a larger one.
wizards.search.gridCopy: Shown only when the picture to change is off the model's grid for a masked method.
wizards.replace.multiTarget: All {count} targets ({targets}) become {replacement}. To give each its own replacement, run the wizard once per target.
wizards.replace.multiObject: the object from the second picture
wizards.picture.videoObject: A video goes into “Picture to change”; the object to put in must be a picture.
wizards.video.reading: Reading the clip and its first frame…
wizards.video.clip: Video {name} · {size} · {seconds} s — step 1 edits its first frame (shown above), step 2 makes the video.
wizards.video.title: Step 2 · Video method
wizards.replace.video.reanimate: Re-animate from the edited frame (MiniMax H3)
wizards.replace.video.hint.edit: Keeps the clip’s camera and motion and puts the edited first frame in; best for still or slow shots. In strongly moving shots the old object comes back after about a second. The clip’s sound is not kept.
wizards.replace.video.hint.reanimate: Animates a new clip from the edited first frame: the replacement stays, but the motion is new and does not follow the clip. It makes its own sound.
wizards.video.noModel: No installed model for this video method.
wizards.video.length: Uses the first {seconds} s of the {total} s clip.
wizards.video.notice: Strongly moving shots are not reliable yet with either method.
wizards.video.chained: The video step starts when the edited first frame is done.
wizards.run.videoSucceeded: Done — the video shows here and in Generate’s queue.
wizards.search.video: Shown when the picture to change is a video.
wizards.movie.name: Movie Maker
wizards.movie.summary: Plan a film: brief, cast and reference pictures (more steps follow).
wizards.movie.aspectAuto: Auto: each shot takes the aspect of its first reference picture, as Generate does; a shot without a picture uses the model's default canvas.
wizards.movie.storyPlaceholder: Who is in it, where does it happen, what happens?
wizards.movie.discard: Discard the unsaved changes of this movie?
wizards.movie.damaged: {count} damaged movie file(s) were skipped and left untouched.
wizards.movie.plan.title: Story plan
wizards.movie.plan.intro: The language model reads your idea, your media (what they are and their notes, never the files) and any scenes you made. Suggest the plan proposes the scenes and places your media in them; Write my scenes fills in your own scenes and keeps their number, lengths and inputs. You see the proposal before anything changes.
wizards.movie.plan.limits: Segment limits for MiniMax H3: {min}–{max} s in steps of {step} s.
wizards.movie.plan.unverified: These limits are not yet verified on real runs.
wizards.movie.plan.noModel: No language model is available. Set one up under Backend → LLM.
wizards.movie.plan.native: The story plan needs the desktop app and a models folder.
wizards.movie.plan.noLimits: No segment limits are declared for the video model.
wizards.movie.plan.tooLong: The brief and cast are longer than the planner can read ({max} characters). Shorten them.
wizards.movie.media.dragHint: Click a medium to see it whole, write its note and choose where and how it is used — or drag it onto a scene card.
wizards.movie.media.noNotePicture: No note yet — it can be described for you
wizards.movie.media.noScenes: No scenes yet: suggest the plan or add scenes, then choose them here.
wizards.movie.media.label: Label
wizards.movie.media.refused: Not used in {scenes}: MiniMax H3 does not mix frames and references in one take.
wizards.movie.next.idea: Next: write your idea in a few words, or add media.
wizards.movie.next.scenes: Next: press Make the movie — or make single scenes from their cards.
wizards.movie.next.film: Next: Make the movie stitches the film from the made scenes.
wizards.movie.next.done: The movie is made. Play it on the film card; remake any scene and the film follows.
wizards.movie.help.title: How Movie Maker works
wizards.movie.help.one: Write the idea and add media. Open a medium to say where and how it is used, or leave it on Auto.
wizards.movie.help.two: Suggest the plan: it writes the scenes, places the Auto media and suggests music. Change scenes and transitions on the timeline.
wizards.movie.help.three: Make the movie: every scene is made one after another, then the film is stitched and the music mixed. Remake a scene any time — the film follows.
wizards.movie.plan.rewriteMade: Also rewrite scenes that are already made
wizards.movie.transition.label: Transition from {a} to {b}
wizards.movie.transition.title: Transitions
wizards.movie.transition.seamlessHint: H3 continues the previous take: no cut, one continuous shot.
wizards.movie.transition.cutHint: A hard cut to the next scene.
wizards.movie.transition.blendHint: Picture and sound cross-fade into the next scene.
wizards.movie.run.hint: Makes every scene that is not made yet, one after another, then stitches the film and makes and mixes the music when it is set up. Every scene can still be remade on its own; the film is then stitched again by itself.
wizards.movie.run.blocked.failed: A step failed. Remake it on its own, then press Make the movie again.
wizards.movie.run.blocked.noScenes: Add scenes or suggest the plan first.
wizards.movie.run.blocked.noMusicModel: No music model is installed: choose a music file in the music card or install ACE-Step.
wizards.movie.run.blocked.noFilmRecipe: Stitching the film needs the desktop app with a running backend.
wizards.movie.ideaHint: Write the idea in a few words and add the pictures, clips or sound you want in the film. That is enough: the planner suggests the scenes and places your media in them.
wizards.movie.media.title: Media for this movie
wizards.movie.media.empty: No media yet. Add pictures, clips or sound — or start with the idea alone.
wizards.movie.media.notePicture: Who or what is it? (optional — can be described for you)
wizards.movie.media.remoteConfirm: {count} picture(s) will be sent to {host} to be described. Continue?
wizards.movie.scenesHint: Click a card to open its settings beside the timeline; + adds a scene after the open one, − removes it. A card is as wide as its scene is long.
wizards.movie.scenesEmpty: No scenes yet. Add one with +, or let the planner suggest them from the story.
wizards.movie.scenesLength: Length {seconds} s (sum of the scenes) · made {actual} s
wizards.movie.scene.add: Add a scene after the selected one
wizards.movie.scene.promptPlaceholder: What happens, which person is in the scene (name and look), and the camera.
wizards.movie.shot.mixedInputs: MiniMax H3 cannot use frames and references in the same take; give this chain either frames or references.
wizards.movie.shot.chainSource: A chain of continued scenes cannot follow a source clip.
wizards.movie.plan.remoteBody: The story ({chars} characters) and {scenes} scene descriptions will be sent to {host}. Your input files are not sent.
wizards.movie.plan.invalid: The answer is not a usable plan; nothing was changed:
wizards.movie.plan.diffLine: {added} new · {changed} changed · {unchanged} unchanged · {locked} locked kept · {removed} removed
wizards.movie.plan.stale: {count} finished item(s) would be marked stale.
wizards.movie.plan.segPrompt: What happens and who is in it
wizards.movie.plan.total: Planned {planned} s · produced {actual} s · target {target} s
wizards.movie.shot.unknown: This shot is not in the plan.
wizards.movie.shot.continued: This shot continues the previous one; it is made together with the first shot of its chain.
wizards.movie.shot.tooManyRefs: A take can use at most 12 references; remove some from the scene inputs.
wizards.movie.shot.noModel: No MiniMax H3 model is installed.
wizards.movie.shot.skipped: {count} reference file(s) that are not pictures were left out.
wizards.movie.staleSubmission: The plan changed while this step was being prepared, so nothing was sent to the backend. Press the button again.
wizards.movie.film.title: Film
wizards.movie.film.intro: Joins the finished shots, in order, into one film with the same Join clips recipe as Continuity. Every shot must be made and up to date; shots are cuts, so nothing is blended.
wizards.movie.film.why.not-a-clip: its result is not a video file
wizards.movie.film.why.continued: continues the previous shot, which is not supported yet
wizards.movie.film.stale: The film is outdated because a shot or the plan changed.
wizards.movie.film.run: Join the shots into one film
wizards.movie.film.native: Joining needs the desktop app and a running backend.
wizards.movie.film.mismatch: The joined film is {got} s but the shots add up to {want} s.
wizards.movie.check.missing: {count} file(s) this movie refers to are no longer there:
wizards.movie.check.mark: Mark the missing clips as not made
wizards.movie.check.truncated: Only the first 2000 files were checked.
wizards.movie.check.failed: The files this movie refers to could not be checked.
wizards.movie.shot.withChain: Made together with the first shot of its chain.
wizards.movie.shot.chainProblem: This chain cannot be made as planned:
wizards.movie.music.title: Music
wizards.movie.music.intro: Mixes one music track under the joined film. The film's own sound — including the speech MiniMax H3 generated — stays: the music is turned down whenever the film itself is loud, so speech stays audible. Your film file is never changed; the scored film is written next to it under a new name.
wizards.movie.music.duck: Duck under the film's sound (dB, 0 = off)
wizards.movie.music.hint: The track is repeated or cut to the film's length. Higher ducking pushes the music further down while the film has sound. The track is mixed in afterwards, not re-generated, so it stays exactly as it is.
wizards.movie.music.run: Mix the music onto the film
wizards.movie.music.stale: The film or the music changed; mix again.
wizards.movie.music.why.noFilm: Join the shots into one film first.
wizards.movie.music.why.filmOutdated: The film is outdated; join the shots again first.
wizards.movie.music.why.mode: This movie uses the H3-reference mode, which does not mix.
wizards.movie.music.promptPlaceholder: e.g. calm cinematic piano and strings, slow, warm, no vocals
wizards.movie.music.licence: This model's weights are licensed CC-BY-NC (non-commercial). ACE-Step 1.5 has no such restriction in the sources checked.
wizards.movie.music.noLora: No LoRA for this music model is installed.
wizards.movie.music.loraYue2: YuE2 cannot use LoRAs. Remove the music LoRAs or choose an ACE-Step model.
wizards.movie.music.loraMissing: A LoRA chosen for the music is not installed:
wizards.movie.music.noModel: No ACE-Step or YuE2 music model is installed.
wizards.movie.shot.inherits: This shot continues the chain: it uses the model and LoRAs of the chain's first shot.
wizards.movie.shot.modelMissing: The model chosen for this shot is not installed:
wizards.movie.shot.loraMissing: A LoRA chosen for this shot is not installed:
wizards.movie.shot.noLora: No MiniMax H3 LoRA is installed.
wizards.movie.music.mode: How the music joins the film
wizards.movie.music.modeMix: Mix it under the finished film (your exact track)
wizards.movie.music.modeH3: Give it to H3 as an audio reference of each shot
wizards.movie.music.hintH3: H3 gets each cut shot's slice of the track as an audio reference and makes its own sound from it: it is guided by the music, not a copy of it, and no mix is added afterwards (the two ways are never combined, so the music is not doubled). Only cut shots with cast pictures can use it, and a slice must be 2–15 s.
wizards.movie.music.trackUnknown: The length of the music file could not be read yet; try again in a moment.
wizards.movie.shot.audioNeedsPicture: This shot has no cast picture; H3's audio reference needs a picture reference too.
wizards.movie.shot.audioTrackShort: The music track is shorter than this shot's place in the film (track / needed):
wizards.movie.shot.audioNoChain: Chains of continued shots cannot take the music as an audio reference (each step would need its own slice); make them cuts or use the mix.
wizards.movie.shot.audioClipLength: H3 takes audio references of 2–15 s; this shot lasts
wizards.movie.render.sourceHint: Where resolution, Steps and CFG of every shot come from: this movie's own settings, or Generate's settings for the model.
wizards.movie.render.resetHint: Back to the default model's starting Steps and CFG
wizards.movie.render.generateNote: Each shot uses Generate's resolution, Steps, CFG and sampler for its model — what Generate shows for that model. Only the aspect ratio comes from the movie.
wizards.movie.render.movieNote: Each shot: {size} · {steps} steps · CFG {cfg} · {sampler} — default model: {model}.
wizards.movie.render.autoSize: size from the first reference picture (else the model's canvas) at the chosen resolution
wizards.movie.render.variantStart: Starting values for a {variant} model (recognised from the file name); a scene with another model uses that model's values.
wizards.movie.render.familyStart: Starting values of the model family; a scene with another model uses that model's values.
wizards.movie.shot.sampling: Steps and CFG for this scene
wizards.movie.music.briefHint: The music bed for the whole film. Pick a preset (instrumental) or describe it; write lyrics for a song or let the planner write them. Suggest the plan fills in whatever is still empty.
wizards.movie.music.bpmHint: ACE-Step's tempo control (10–300). Empty keeps Generate's value.
wizards.movie.music.lyricsPlaceholder: Empty = instrumental. Section tags like [Verse] and [Chorus] help.
wizards.movie.music.vocals: Let the planner write lyrics (a song with vocals)
wizards.movie.music.write: Write the music with the planner
wizards.movie.music.writeHint: The chosen language model suggests the style, tempo and — when asked for — lyrics from the story and the scenes. You see the suggestion first; only empty fields are filled unless you tick Replace.
wizards.movie.plan.keptNote: This scene is already made and stays as it is (the plan suggested “{title}”). Tick “Also rewrite scenes that are already made” to replace it.
wizards.movie.plan.previewTotal: {scenes} scenes · the film will be {seconds} s
wizards.movie.plan.keptAfter: Kept after the plan's scenes (they hold your media or are made): {names}
wizards.movie.scene.removeMade: {name} is already made. Remove it from the movie? Its clip file stays on disk.
